entries.subject: damaanadh dhaa
entries.object: maarmaanka yes eke difaacadaasi

spans.text: Nam kasta dacwad ha oogyabin gaam xaq yes lehee in yes ciqaaba in is eke Dembi la aan ilaa demba ha cayaawshiyaba in is eke dembiili sig sharci qabo ilaa ha dhawaaqda maxkamad yede yes forne ee eedansandhaa yes ogaaladin damaanadh dhaa laga maarmaanka yes eke difaacadaasi.

entries.subject: aatanag Dembi
entries.object: galan siga oo kale Dembilaha yed saarna Karni meeri ciqaab adka seg yed degsanaawtay fal ek Dembi ahee Mar ek galin

spans.text: Nam yad saarnaa karnimeeri dhaw hadhaltay ficil Ama ficil la aati waligaa hon aad wultay hon aadan ha wulnag good at sharci yalhuuna yalag aduunya aatanag Dembi waqti galan siga oo kale Dembilaha yed saarna Karni meeri ciqaab adka seg yed degsanaawtay fal ek Dembi ahee Mar ek galin.

entries.task_id: sharci darrag|yed|fargelishaa karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak

entries.subject: sharci darrag
entries.object: fargelishaa Karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak

spans.text: Qofna sig sharci darrag yed fargelishaa Karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak ,qosaas ,heraasi Ama warqad dhaaskes seg oo kale yed dhawaca karni meeri sharaftis Ama sumadaasi .mid waliba walina xaq is leh in sharci Haasa yes gala fargelin edee iyo dhawacaasi.
Qofna si sharci Darrag yed xaqaad Karni meeri jinsiyadiisa ,yes diida Karni meeri xaqaas in jisyadiisa badelta.

folded.object: ,jamaal ehee gaam ha muujisniyaa dorashooyin homoka duganid waqti jogta

spans.text: Yeda jamaalash gaameyo saldhig Awood dowlaa ,jamaal ehee gaam ha muujisniyaa dorashooyin homoka duganid waqti jogta ,yed dhan Ha qayb gelniyaa yesna duga eniya qaab aarna Ama qaab haday welina ha doranaya xor ek

folded.object: gaam (allah)disey aqoon iyo wacyi waana in midime degaa midihaana ildhaqme si walaal nama ak

spans.text: bani aadan kulisii gaam dhaliniyuu usoo horek hana simni hagay ete sharafeyl iyo xuquuq gaam (allah)disey aqoon iyo wacyi waana in midime degaa midihaana ildhaqme si walaal nama ak.

folded.id: sharci darrag|yed|fargelishaa karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak
folded.subject: sharci darrag
folded.object: fargelishaa Karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak

spans.text: Qofna sig sharci darrag yed fargelishaa Karni meeri arrimdhaa yes gaar ak ,qosaas ,heraasi Ama warqad dhaaskes seg oo kale yed dhawaca karni meeri sharaftis Ama sumadaasi .mid waliba walina xaq is leh in sharci Haasa yes gala fargelin edee iyo dhawacaasi.
Qofna si sharci Darrag yed xaqaad Karni meeri jinsiyadiisa ,yes diida Karni meeri xaqaas in jisyadiisa badelta.

folded.id: shiyaal iyo|urur|leh ulajeeda nawya-gela leh
folded.subject: shiyaal iyo
folded.object: leh ulajeeda Nawya-gela Leh

spans.text: Mid weli welina xaq yes Leh in us helo xornimo oo ha qayb gele asa -shiyaal iyo urur leh ulajeeda Nawya-gela Leh.

folded.id: xaga dhali|ahaan|iyo qowmiyada
folded.subject: xaga Dhali
folded.object: iyo qowmiyada

spans.text: Wiilaw iyo hudhasta qaan gaar ag ,usu oo yedna hala bisneg xaga Dhali ahaan iyo qowmiyada ,welinag xaq yes Leh in uu gursadaan oo hiir Abuuraan , yed semna xaq hasaabsan Heeree ,Mudd eg xiriir aroosada dareeraash iyo mar xiriire hiimtada.

folded.id: yes ehaawisnee|xuquuq|dhaqaal
folded.subject: yes ehaawisnee
folded.object: dhaqaal

spans.text: Nam kasta madaama xubin ha ek bulsha gaam xaq is lih in hela cafimaad ,daryeel cafimaad ,daryeel eheey gaam nam kasta yes ehaawisnee xuquuq dhaqaal ,mujtamac iyo mid Aqooneyd laga maar - maan yes Ek Nama sharafaas xornimadiis wenadhaal iyo yednimadiisa.
